projects.title: Relief Motion Physiotherapy
projects.tagline: A mark that turns an R and an M into a person in motion
projects.short: One identity carried from the reception wall to the staff ID badge, so the clinic looks as caring and professional as its care.
projects.brief: Relief Motion is a physiotherapy practice offering home visits and online consultations. It needed an identity that looked as caring and professional as the treatment itself, in a clinic, on a doorway and on a phone screen.
projects.identity: We joined an R and an M into a figure moving freely, in calm navy and healing teal. The mark then travels across wall signage, glass door vinyl, business cards, staff ID badges, letterhead and service graphics, so every touchpoint feels like the same practice.
images: Relief Motion Physiotherapy logo on a marble reception wall
Relief Motion Physiotherapy staff ID badge and lanyard
Relief Motion Physiotherapy acrylic wall sign
Relief Motion Physiotherapy glass door vinyl

projects.title: Three Strands Health & Wellness
projects.tagline: A mark that reads as a flowing strand and a face in profile
projects.short: One mark carried from reception signage to print and social, so the practice looks like itself everywhere.
projects.brief: Three Strands is a psychiatric and family nurse practice. Its identity had to feel calm, credible and personal before a patient reads a single word.
projects.identity: We drew a mark that reads as both a flowing strand and a face in profile, set in deep purple and gold. It then moves across office signage, a promotional flyer, social media posts and stationery so every touchpoint matches.
images: Three Strands office reception signage featuring the brand mark
Three Strands social media post design
Three Strands logo printed on stationery

projects.title: Abiola Farms
projects.tagline: Rooted in the land, built to read as modern and trustworthy
projects.short: A full visual system for an agricultural business: logo, signage, business cards, stickers and letterhead.
projects.brief: Abiola Farms needed a mark that felt trustworthy and modern while staying rooted in the land, and a system that makes the farm read as one consistent operation wherever it appears.
projects.identity: We built a badge logo that brings the livestock and the fields together, then carried it across entrance signage, business cards, stickers and letterhead.
images: Abiola Farms entrance signage featuring the brand mark

projects.title: Shayan Private Equity
projects.tagline: A restrained identity for a private equity house
projects.short: Logo, letterhead and business cards that give a fund management brand the weight of an established firm.
projects.brief: Shayan is a fund management and equity finance brand that needed to look established from day one, with trust and growth built into the first impression.
projects.identity: We drew a mark that reads as both an S and a rising chart, set in navy with a gold arrow. It sits on a restrained set of stationery: letterhead and business cards that feel like an established firm.
images: Shayan Private Equity business card mockup

projects.title: Zavron Group
projects.tagline: Signage, stationery and packaging across the Zavron family
projects.short: A parent identity that holds together its sister brands across warehouse signage, glass walls and packaging.
projects.brief: Zavron is a trade and distribution business operating across Nigeria and Ghana. It needed one parent identity strong enough to sit beside its sister brands, Zavia and Zuria.
projects.identity: We built a Z mark of arrows in motion, with the line Connecting African Commerce, and carried it onto warehouse signage, office glass, packaging and business cards that also introduce the sister brands.
images: Zavron business card featuring Zavia and Zuria

projects.title: Zavia Apparel
projects.tagline: Monograms and metallics for a fashion label
projects.short: A ZA monogram worked into leather, bags, hardware and garment tags.
projects.brief: Zavia is a sister brand under the Zavron Group umbrella, a fashion label positioned at the top end of the market. The identity had to feel premium on a bag clasp as much as on a swing tag.
projects.identity: We designed a monogrammed ZA mark in deep maroon and gold, then carried it onto leather goods hardware, shopping bags, metal accessories and garment tags.
images: Zavia Apparel metallic logo mockups on cufflinks and tie clip

projects.title: Zuria Cosmetics
projects.tagline: Soft packaging and a campaign look for a cosmetics line
projects.short: A cosmetics identity from hero banner to jars, bags and perfume bottle.
projects.brief: Zuria is a skincare and cosmetics line, another sister brand under Zavron Group. It needed a clean, botanical identity that feels like clean luxury on a shelf and on a screen.
projects.identity: We built the identity around a lotus mark in forest green and soft gold, then carried it across product jars, shopping bags, a perfume bottle and a campaign banner.

services.name: Logo design
services.text: A distinctive primary mark, with the colour, one-colour and compact versions a business actually needs.

services.name: Brand identity
services.text: Logo, colour, type and usage rules that keep a brand consistent everywhere it appears.

services.name: Print and stationery
services.text: Business cards, letterheads, ID badges, flyers and the other printed pieces a business hands out.

services.name: Social media graphics
services.text: Post and campaign designs that carry the identity into the feed.

services.name: Signage
services.text: Reception walls, acrylic signs, glass vinyl and entrance boards, designed to read from across the room.

services.name: Packaging and labels
services.text: Boxes, bags, jars, tags and stickers that make the brand feel finished.

services.name: Mockups and presentation
services.text: Realistic mockups, so you see the brand in place before anything is printed.

process: We start with your business, your customers and the brands around you, so the work is built on the right brief.
We sketch routes for the mark and the look, and show you the strongest ideas with a clear reason behind each.
Together we sharpen one direction, then build out the colour, type and the pieces you need.
You receive clean final files and the mockups, ready for print, signage and screen.
